requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Requirement is unambiguous and structurally atomic. Decomposed into a functional requirement (sending the email) and a quality requirement (response time constraint) per standard practice for mixed functional/quality statements, despite the lack of explicit concern-mixing flag, to ensure clear separation of behavior and performance criteria.

source_fragments: When a customer submits an order, the system shall send a confirmation email to the customer
structured_requirements.final_statement: When a customer submits an order, the system shall send a confirmation email to the customer.
structuring_notes: Extracted the core functional behavior. The quality constraint was separated to avoid mixing action and timing in a single functional requirement.

fields.condition: after the confirmation email is sent

structured_requirements.final_statement: The system shall send the confirmation email to the customer within 30 seconds.
structuring_notes: Extracted the performance constraint (response time) as a separate quality requirement.
